name: healthy-host-six-ingress

base_results.finding: v2/v3 ingress endpoints hit ~8.33k RPS target; v1 and v4 underdelivered

hypothesis: The current TPS loss is ingress-host delivery imbalance, not consensus throughput. Item 251 proved validator-2 and validator-3 can each sustain the item-219 per-endpoint target (~8.33k RPS) on three ingress services, while validator-1 and validator-4 underdeliver. Adding three more ingress services and sending load only to validator-2 and validator-3 gives twelve healthy endpoints at the same per-endpoint target as item 219 while all four hosts remain consensus validators.

planned_commands.description: deploy six ingress services per host using committed experiment vars
verify six-port topology with same committed experiment vars
wipe chain state and restart six-service topology
planned_commands.command: cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) .venv/bin/ansible kombat_live_testnet -m shell -a 'systemctl stop kombat-chain-ingress6 kombat-chain-ingress5 kombat-chain-ingress4 kombat-chain-ingress3 kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain && rm -rf /var/lib/and-chain && mkdir -p /var/lib/and-chain/snapshots && chown -R and-chain:and-chain /var/lib/and-chain && systemctl start kombat-chain && systemctl start kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress3 kombat-chain-ingress4 kombat-chain-ingress5 kombat-chain-ingress6'

planned_commands.description: run item-219-equivalent endpoint count using only healthy ingress hosts
planned_commands.command: LOADTEST_VALIDATOR_NAMES='validator-2 validator-3' LOADTEST_ENDPOINT_PORTS='8645 8646 8647 8648 8649 8650' LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-252-v2v3-six-ingress-100k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=1 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 100000 60

success_criteria.primary: state roots match at common height, request errors remain zero, all Mahi pools drain after standard drain, and committed TPS meets or exceeds the item-219 green reference of 85,382 TPS
success_criteria.secondary: validator-2 and validator-3 endpoints stay near the proven ~8.33k RPS target band across all six ports

result.decision: Binned. The healthy-host six-ingress topology raised accepted load but caused large Mahi pre-admitted backlogs and state-root divergence at common height 49. The overload changes protocol behavior under drain pressure and is not a safe green recovery path.
